name: multi_indicator_consensus_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Individual technical indicators have low signal-to-noise ratios on 1-min bars. By requiring consensus from 5 diverse indicators (VWAP position, RSI, MACD, Stochastic, and Volume Rate of Change), we filter out noise and only trade when multiple independent lenses agree. The inefficiency persists because most traders use 1-2 indicators; requiring 5/5 or 4/5 agreement dramatically reduces false signals but also reduces frequency, making it unattractive to high-frequency desks that need volume. The edge comes from precision: fewer trades but higher win rate.
mechanism: Multiple independent signals confirming the same direction increase the probability that a genuine order flow imbalance exists, not just noise. When momentum, volume, and volatility signals align, it indicates that institutional activity is creating measurable market impact across multiple dimensions simultaneously, increasing the confidence of directional prediction.

exit.signal_exit: Consensus_Score drops to 0 (neutral) or flips sign

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; reduce position to ₹75K if VIX > 20

weaknesses: Very low signal frequency — requiring 4/5 consensus with 2-bar confirmation may produce only 0-1 trades per day across entire NIFTY 50 universe
Indicators are correlated (RSI, Stochastic, MACD all derived from price) — consensus may overweight price momentum and underweight independent information
Target/stop ratio of 40/25 = 1.6 is tight; with 63% win rate, the strategy is fragile — a 5% drop in win rate makes it unprofitable after costs
prior_art: Elder's Triple Screen System; consensus/voting systems discussed in Pardo's 'Design, Testing, and Optimization of Trading Systems'; multiple confirmation approaches common in retail TA
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
